verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- mā·ḥă·laṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·mar nā·ḇāl bə·lib·bōw ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm hiš·ḥî·ṯū wə·hiṯ·‘î·ḇū ‘ā·wel ’ên ‘ō·śêh- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Mahalath A Maskil of David The fool says in his heart There is no God They are corrupt their ways are vile There is no one who does good

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־ בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm miš·šā·ma·yim hiš·qîp̄ ‘al- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām lir·’ō·wṯ hă·yêš maś·kîl dō·rêš ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand if any seek God

verses.original: כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lōw sāḡ yaḥ·dāw ne·’ĕ·lā·ḥū ’ên ‘ō·śêh- ṭō·wḇ ’ên gam- ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: All have turned away they have together become corrupt there is no one who does good not even one

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō yā·ḏə·‘ū pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen ’ō·ḵə·lê ‘am·mî ’ā·ḵə·lū le·ḥem ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō qā·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Will the workers of iniquity never learn They devour my people like bread they refuse to call upon God

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם׀ פָּֽחֲדוּ־ פַחַד֮ לֹא־ הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šām pā·ḥă·ḏū- p̄a·ḥaḏ lō- hā·yāh p̄ā·ḥaḏ kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm piz·zar ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ḥō·nāḵ hĕ·ḇi·šō·ṯāh kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm mə·’ā·sām
verses.literal: There they are overwhelmed with dread where there was nothing to fear For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you You put them to shame for God has despised them

verses.original: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשֻׁע֪וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·tên miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn yə·šu·‘ō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl bə·šūḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm šə·ḇūṯ ‘am·mōw yā·ḡêl ya·‘ă·qōḇ yiś·maḥ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion When God restores His captive people let Jacob rejoice let Israel be glad
